profiles.name: Portable knowledge-only copy
profiles.source_contract: Copies named file and directory groups, does not register hooks or update client permissions. Contains hook-related Python helper source but excludes hooks/hooks.json and plugin manifest.

profiles.name: Claude plugin
profiles.source_contract: PreToolUse and Stop hooks invoke scripts/claude_hook.py, 10s and 15s timeouts.

profiles.name: Legacy copy/link
profiles.source_contract: Alternative full-checkout install/copy paths, may include plugin descriptors and hooks; not equivalent to portable copy.

inspected_sources.note: Read during boundary analysis; Git blob not separately recorded

observed_positive_methods: Scope before action; read-only review does not grant external/network/hardware authority.
Separates permission to attempt physical tests, readiness to execute, operator-only execution and actual evidence.
L0-L6 verification levels keep simulated/ROS software results distinct from hardware operation.
Distinguishes installed runtime parameters and actual process from source-file speculation.
Portable installation explicitly excludes hook registration; optional plugin path is separate.
risk_to_qualify: Source portable selection includes 118 pinned blobs, not merely root SKILL.md. Must examine all package-owned executable/docs files before full ten-axis disposition.
Installer copies scripts/ directory (15 Python tools), including launch_supervisor.py which launches real processes when authorized; action policy needed per tool.
Claude plugin registers event hooks; static regex validators explicitly say they are not security/safety boundaries; separate plugin profile assessment needed.
Full checkout legacy install and link profile may expose plugin manifests; never assume portable installation semantics apply.
Source README reports prior CI fixtures and examples but these are not observed host acceptance for our exact installation; do not claim runtime/physical validation.
No detached portable Git tree exists from the 118 selected paths; compute a stable manifest/digest for exact copied bytes before promoting a portable package.
Per-file rights/notice audit beyond full root Apache-2.0 license not complete.
next_actions: Construct a complete exact-pin portable bundle manifest from the source 118 selected blobs, including per-file rights and SHA.
Perform static inspection of all 15 bundled Python scripts, 28 reference files and live-action/hook paths; then independent threat review.
Run isolated safe install/no-clobber/rollback behavior tests in a disposable host, with no ROS or physical hardware connected.
Only then record a bounded ten-axis disposition, separate for portable and Claude plugin profiles, with no claim of hardware safety.
